tools.name: laen_find_blockers
tools.description: FREE. Search LAEN's live blocker feed (universal blocker schema) for execution blockers matching a failure signature. Returns fundable blockers with gap_type, failing_assertion, resolution_contract (x402), resolution_state (KNOWN_RESOLUTION = instant), and measured latency where available.

tools.name: laen_quote
tools.description: FREE. Get the price and EXACT x402 payment requirements for resolving one blocker. Use the returned requirements.accepts[0] to construct/sign your payment with your own x402 client (e.g. x402-fetch createPaymentHeader). Never share keys.

tools.name: laen_resolve
tools.description: PAID (your wallet). Submit your SIGNED x402 payment payload (the base64 X-PAYMENT header value your client produced for this blocker's requirements) and receive the resolution: independently verifiable evidence (+ anchored certificate with verify_url if product=certificate). Fail-closed: no valid se

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "laen-mcp" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: laen_find_blockers · Private data: laen_resolve · Public sink: laen_quote, laen_resolve.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: laen_find_blockers · Private data: laen_resolve · Public sink: laen_quote, laen_resolve

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
